chars.GIRL: a Moroccan teenage girl about 17 with long dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers, a small black backpack
chars.BROTHER: a Moroccan teenage boy about 17 with short curly black hair, wearing a red track jacket with two white stripes on the sleeves and black joggers
chars.DAD: a Moroccan man in his fifties with a grey moustache and short grey hair, wearing a beige djellaba over a white shirt
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her late forties wearing a lavender headscarf and a dark green house kaftan

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Outside a Moroccan public high school gate in Sale, afternoon. Seen from a few metres away like a classmate watching: BROTHER storms up furious, pointing his finger at GIRL's face and shouting, GIRL flinches back holding her cheek, shocked; a schoolboy in a grey sweater steps away in the blurred background. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, comic-dramatic 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Earlier at the same high school gate: GIRL stands chatting and smiling shyly with a teenage boy in a grey sweater holding his books, other students around in the background, then she notices someone coming and her smile freezes. 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan living room with blue sedari sofas and a low round table: GIRL just came home and stands in the middle crying angrily and shouting, one hand on her red cheek, pointing back toward the door; DAD and MOM stand up from the sofa surprised and worried. 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room in the evening: DAD stands and scolds BROTHER sternly, pointing at him, while BROTHER sits on the sedari sofa with his head down, silent and sulking. 2D cartoon style, faces visible, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same living room, a little later: DAD sits next to GIRL on the sofa and talks to her seriously with a raised hand, GIRL listens with wet eyes and a confused, curious face. 2D cartoon style, faces visible, no text.
